name: Ontario County, NY
findings: Ontario County has 383 nonprofit organizations. 210 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 174 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ontario County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Ontario County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 102 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
